summary: This independent static landing page introduces agensis, links visitors to the app and source, and explains features, team collaboration, pricing, and the optional cloud-storage waitlist.

tour.say: The top navigation links to Features, For teams, and the GitHub project.
The hero frames agensis as a collaborative workspace for chat, documents, memory, files, and a shared realtime canvas.
Features covers the canvas, inline AI chat, documents, memory, live presence, and local-first setup.
The teams section explains workspaces, member roles, local windows, presence, and shared canvas context.
Pricing says the app is free to run locally and presents optional cloud storage with a waitlist call to action.
The footer keeps the brand and licensing details visible.

/.summary: The landing homepage with hero, features, team collaboration, pricing, and waitlist sections.
